senses.en: to say something more
senses.pattern: add that… / he added / I should add (that)…
senses.example: The coach praised the team's effort and [[added]] that Friday's practice would start an hour early.
senses.example_zh: 教練稱讚了全隊的努力，並補充說週五的練習會提早一小時開始。

gsat.sentence: But, he [[added]], “I love my brother very much.
I should [[add]], perhaps, that I did tell my friends what had happened to them, after the event was over, and gave them the option of destroying the tape.

senses.en: to be held responsible for something
senses.pattern: answer for one's actions / answer for the consequences / answer to sb for sth
senses.example: Anyone who damages the school's lab equipment on purpose will have to [[answer]] for it.
senses.example_zh: 任何故意損壞學校實驗室設備的人，都必須對此負責。
senses.note: answer to sb＝向某人負責

senses.en: to match a description or satisfy a need
senses.pattern: answer a description / answer a need / answer the purpose
senses.example: A man [[answering]] the witness's description was seen leaving the museum shortly before the alarm rang.
senses.example_zh: 有人看到一名符合目擊者描述的男子，在警報響起前不久離開博物館。

senses.en: a formal meeting with an important person
senses.pattern: an audience with the king / grant sb an audience / request an audience / a private audience
senses.example: After waiting for three months, the young explorer was finally granted an [[audience]] with the queen.
senses.example_zh: 等了三個月之後，這位年輕的探險家終於獲准謁見女王。

senses.en: the people who read, watch, or listen to a particular medium
senses.pattern: target audience / reach a wider audience / a young audience
senses.example: Her science blog reaches an [[audience]] of over fifty thousand readers in more than twenty countries.
senses.example_zh: 她的科學部落格擁有遍及二十多國、超過五萬人的讀者群。

gsat.sentence: Newspapers, radio and TV stations, and websites have participated in the April 1 tradition of making fictional reports in order to fool their [[audiences]].

senses.en: a living creature, especially a person
senses.pattern: a human being / living beings / intelligent beings / beings from outer space
senses.example: Scientists still wonder whether intelligent [[beings]] exist on planets far beyond our solar system.
senses.example_zh: 科學家仍想知道，在遠離太陽系的行星上是否存在有智慧的生物。

senses.en: the state of existing
senses.pattern: come into being / bring sth into being
senses.example: Nobody knows exactly when the village's famous lantern festival first came into [[being]].
senses.example_zh: 沒有人確切知道這個村莊著名的燈籠節最初是何時誕生的。
senses.note: 此義不可數；come into being＝形成

gsat.sentence: Many people believe that [[beings]] from outer space have visited us for centuries.
Roy Sullivan, a park ranger in the United States, was struck by lightning more recorded times than any other human [[being]].

senses.en: to face danger or bad conditions with courage
senses.pattern: brave the storm / brave the cold / brave the crowds / brave the elements
senses.example: Hundreds of fans [[braved]] the heavy rain to watch the school band's final outdoor concert.
senses.example_zh: 數百名樂迷冒著大雨，觀賞學校樂隊的最後一場戶外音樂會。

senses.en: to give a vote in an election
senses.pattern: cast a vote / cast a ballot / cast one's vote for sb
senses.example: More than two thousand students [[cast]] their votes in this year's student council election.
senses.example_zh: 兩千多名學生在今年的學生會選舉中投了票。
senses.note: 三態同形：cast–cast–cast

senses.en: to throw light, shadow, or doubt on something
senses.pattern: cast a shadow / cast doubt on / cast light on / cast a glance at
senses.example: The tall trees along the river [[cast]] long shadows across the path in the late afternoon.
senses.example_zh: 傍晚時分，河邊的高大樹木在小徑上投射出長長的影子。

senses.en: a hard cover that protects a broken bone
senses.pattern: in a cast / wear a cast / a plaster cast
senses.example: After falling off his bike, Kevin had to wear a [[cast]] on his left arm for six weeks.
senses.example_zh: 凱文從腳踏車上摔下來後，左手臂必須打六個星期的石膏。

senses.en: of very high quality
senses.pattern: choice beef / choice fruit / choice cuts of meat / the choicest ingredients
senses.example: The restaurant is famous for serving only [[choice]] cuts of beef from nearby farms.
senses.example_zh: 這家餐廳以只供應來自附近農場的上等牛肉聞名。
senses.note: 只置於名詞前；最高級 choicest

senses.en: feeling relaxed and confident about something
senses.pattern: be comfortable with / feel comfortable doing / be comfortable speaking in public
senses.example: Not every student feels [[comfortable]] asking questions in front of the whole class.
senses.example_zh: 並非每個學生都能自在地在全班面前發問。

senses.en: having enough money to live well
senses.pattern: a comfortable income / a comfortable living / a comfortable retirement
senses.example: The retired couple are not rich, but they are [[comfortable]] enough to travel abroad every year.
senses.example_zh: 這對退休夫婦並不富有，但生活夠寬裕，每年都能出國旅行。
senses.note: comfortably off＝生活寬裕

gsat.sentence: Most of us are [[comfortable]] with eye contact lasting a few seconds.
However, since it kept orbiting around the Earth without any consequences, scientists became increasingly [[comfortable]] abandoning things that no longer served any useful purpose in space.

senses.en: to look in a book or map for information
senses.pattern: consult a dictionary / consult a map / consult the manual / consult one's notes
senses.example: Lost in the old town, the tourists stopped to [[consult]] the map on the station wall.
senses.example_zh: 在舊城區迷路後，遊客們停下來查閱車站牆上的地圖。

senses.en: a bat-and-ball game played by two teams of eleven
senses.pattern: play cricket / a cricket match / a cricket team / a cricket bat
senses.example: In India and Australia, millions of fans stay up late to watch important [[cricket]] matches.
senses.example_zh: 在印度和澳洲，數以百萬計的球迷會熬夜觀看重要的板球比賽。
senses.note: 此義不可數

gsat.sentence: He explained that he had just retired and was happiest when he could see or hear boys playing his favorite game, [[cricket]].
An old man who lived in a small side street of Mumbai had to put up with the nuisance of boys playing [[cricket]] and making a lot of noise outside his house, at night.

senses.en: to find out the facts about something
senses.pattern: determine the cause of / determine whether… / determine the age of
senses.example: Firefighters are still trying to [[determine]] the cause of the fire that destroyed the old theater.
senses.example_zh: 消防人員仍在設法查明燒毀舊戲院那場火災的起因。

senses.en: to be the thing that controls a result
senses.pattern: be determined by / determine the outcome / determine the price
senses.example: The amount of sleep you get largely [[determines]] how well you can concentrate in class.
senses.example_zh: 睡眠時間的多寡，在很大程度上決定了你上課時能有多專心。
senses.note: 主詞為「因素」，非「人做決定」

gsat.sentence: This comparative advantage is [[determined]] by key factors of production such as land, capital, and labor.
Once the questions are finished, the examiner analyzes the results to [[determine]] if the person tested was being truthful.

senses.en: to force someone or something into a state or action
senses.pattern: drive sb crazy / drive sb to do sth / be driven by / the driving force
senses.example: Hunger and the bitter cold finally [[drove]] the lost hikers to seek shelter in a cave.
senses.example_zh: 飢餓和嚴寒最後迫使迷路的登山客到洞穴裡躲避。

senses.en: energy and determination to succeed
senses.pattern: have the drive to do sth / lack drive / drive and ambition
senses.example: Talent alone is not enough; a young athlete also needs the [[drive]] to train every day.
senses.example_zh: 光有天分是不夠的；年輕運動員還需要每天訓練的幹勁。
senses.note: 此義不可數

senses.en: an organized effort by a group to achieve something
senses.pattern: a blood drive / a food drive / a fund-raising drive / a recycling drive
senses.example: Our class organized a book [[drive]] and collected five hundred books for a village library.
senses.example_zh: 我們班發起了募書活動，為一座鄉村圖書館募集了五百本書。

gsat.sentence: Trade is certainly a main [[driving]] force for globalization.
The barking of the hound, which [[drives]] deer to panic, strengthens the effect of the warning noise, according to the RTRI.

senses.en: to have something good, such as a right or advantage
senses.pattern: enjoy good health / enjoy great popularity / enjoy the right to / enjoy a high reputation
senses.example: Thanks to regular exercise, my grandmother still [[enjoys]] excellent health at the age of ninety.
senses.example_zh: 多虧規律運動，我祖母九十歲了仍享有極佳的健康。

gsat.sentence: To no one’s surprise, it has [[enjoyed]] similar popularity.
It has long been assumed that creativity is some unusual trait [[enjoyed]] by the few.

senses.en: not strong or clear; hard to see, hear, or smell
senses.pattern: a faint sound / a faint smell / a faint light / a faint smile
senses.example: We could hear the [[faint]] sound of a piano coming from a house down the street.
senses.example_zh: 我們聽得到從街道那頭一棟房子傳來的微弱鋼琴聲。

senses.en: (of a hope or chance) very small
senses.pattern: a faint hope / a faint chance / not have the faintest idea
senses.example: Rescuers admitted there was only a [[faint]] hope of finding more survivors under the snow.
senses.example_zh: 救難人員坦承，在雪堆下再找到生還者的希望十分微小。
senses.note: not have the faintest idea＝毫無頭緒

senses.en: a business company
senses.pattern: a law firm / an accounting firm / a consulting firm / a firm of architects
senses.example: After graduating from law school, Diane joined a small [[firm]] that helps people start their own businesses.
senses.example_zh: 黛安從法學院畢業後，加入了一家協助人們創業的小型事務所。

gsat.sentence: Moreover, a number of [[firms]] are creating cars that drive themselves to a chosen destination without a human at the controls.
Next, we sold the computers off to Stab, Grab, Grit, and Nasty, a [[firm]] of lawyers nearby.

senses.en: (of water) not salty
senses.pattern: fresh water / a supply of fresh water / fresh and salt water
senses.example: Salmon are born in [[fresh]] water, swim out to sea, and later return to the same river.
senses.example_zh: 鮭魚在淡水中出生，游向大海，之後再回到同一條河流。
senses.note: 形容詞 freshwater：淡水的（置於名詞前）

senses.en: new and different from what existed before
senses.pattern: a fresh start / fresh evidence / a fresh look at / fresh ideas
senses.example: After moving to another city, Brian saw the new school as a chance to make a [[fresh]] start.
senses.example_zh: 搬到另一個城市後，布萊恩把新學校看作一次全新開始的機會。

gsat.sentence: The urgent need to turn seawater into [[fresh]] water.
Its worldwide popularity is mainly due to its theme music, which showcases ABBA’s timeless songs in a [[fresh]] and vital way that retains the essence of both pop music and good musical theater.

senses.en: (of an amount of money) large
senses.pattern: a handsome profit / a handsome sum / a handsome salary / a handsome reward
senses.example: The farmer made a [[handsome]] profit by selling his organic strawberries directly to city customers online.
senses.example_zh: 這位農夫透過網路把有機草莓直接賣給都市顧客，賺了一筆可觀的利潤。
senses.note: 副詞 handsomely：優厚地

senses.en: (of a thing) attractive, well made, and impressive
senses.pattern: a handsome building / a handsome design / a handsome old house
senses.example: The city library is a [[handsome]] stone building that has stood by the river since 1920.
senses.example_zh: 市立圖書館是一棟氣派的石造建築，自 1920 年起就矗立在河邊。

gsat.sentence: Nine proposals were submitted, and the Irish-born architect James Hoban won the gold medal for his practical and [[handsome]] design.

senses.en: to feel that you share someone's feelings or situation
senses.pattern: identify with a character / identify with a group / identify strongly with
senses.example: Many teenage readers [[identify]] with the story's heroine because she struggles with the same worries.
senses.example_zh: 許多青少年讀者對故事的女主角很有共鳴，因為她也為同樣的煩惱所苦。

senses.en: to find or discover a cause, problem, or need
senses.pattern: identify the cause / identify a problem / identify areas for improvement / identify a need
senses.example: The survey helped the school [[identify]] three main reasons why students skip breakfast.
senses.example_zh: 這項調查幫助學校找出學生不吃早餐的三個主要原因。

gsat.sentence: People in this community tend to [[identify]] with the group they belong to, and often put group interests before personal ones.
There are still a lot of questions unanswered, but three main causes have been [[identified]].

senses.en: to end or destroy something such as a plan or feeling
senses.pattern: kill a plan / kill the mood / kill sb's hopes / kill the pain
senses.example: A sudden cut in funding [[killed]] the plan to build a new swimming pool on campus.
senses.example_zh: 經費突然遭到刪減，扼殺了在校園興建新游泳池的計畫。

senses.en: to spend time doing something while waiting
senses.pattern: kill time / kill an hour / have two hours to kill
senses.example: While waiting for the dentist, I [[killed]] time by reading the magazines on the table.
senses.example_zh: 等牙醫看診時，我翻閱桌上的雜誌來消磨時間。

senses.en: to officially end a ban or restriction
senses.pattern: lift a ban / lift restrictions / lift sanctions / lift a curfew
senses.example: City officials [[lifted]] the water restrictions as soon as heavy rain filled the reservoirs again.
senses.example_zh: 大雨一讓水庫再度蓄滿，市府官員就解除了用水限制。

senses.en: (of fog or cloud) to rise and disappear
senses.pattern: the fog lifted / the mist lifts / the clouds lifted
senses.example: By ten o'clock the fog had [[lifted]], and we could finally see the mountains across the lake.
senses.example_zh: 到了十點霧已消散，我們終於看得見湖對岸的群山。

senses.en: a free ride in someone else's car
senses.pattern: give sb a lift / get a lift / offer sb a lift
senses.example: Since the last bus had left, a kind neighbor gave us a [[lift]] to the station.
senses.example_zh: 由於末班公車已經開走，一位好心的鄰居讓我們搭便車到車站。
senses.note: 英式用法；英式 lift 另指「電梯」

senses.en: the amount of matter in an object
senses.pattern: the mass of an object / body mass / muscle mass / mass and weight
senses.example: An astronaut's [[mass]] stays the same on the moon, although his weight becomes much smaller.
senses.example_zh: 太空人的質量在月球上維持不變，但他的重量卻小得多。

senses.en: a large amount of something with no clear shape
senses.pattern: a cold air mass / a mass of clouds / a mass of rock / a solid mass
senses.example: A cold air [[mass]] from the north will bring lower temperatures to the island this weekend.
senses.example_zh: 來自北方的冷氣團本週末將為島上帶來較低的氣溫。

senses.en: the lesson that a story teaches
senses.pattern: the moral of the story / draw a moral from / a story with a moral
senses.example: The [[moral]] of the fable is that honesty is worth more than gold.
senses.example_zh: 這則寓言的寓意是，誠實比黃金更有價值。
senses.note: 複數 morals 指品行；勿混 morale 士氣

senses.en: psychological rather than practical or physical
senses.pattern: moral support / give sb moral support / a moral victory
senses.example: My best friend came to the speech contest just to give me [[moral]] support.
senses.example_zh: 我最好的朋友來到演講比賽現場，只為了給我精神上的支持。

gsat.sentence: Another [[moral]] which also means a great deal is “competition against situations rather than against rivals.”

senses.en: new and different from anything known before
senses.pattern: a novel idea / a novel approach / a novel solution / a novel way
senses.example: The engineers came up with a [[novel]] way to turn ocean waves into electricity.
senses.example_zh: 工程師們想出一種新穎的方法，把海浪轉換成電力。
senses.note: 名詞 novelty：新奇（的事物）

senses.en: soon leaving a position of responsibility
senses.pattern: the outgoing president / the outgoing chairman / the outgoing principal
senses.example: At the ceremony, the [[outgoing]] principal handed the school flag to her successor.
senses.example_zh: 在典禮上，即將卸任的校長把校旗交給她的繼任者。
senses.note: 只置於名詞前；反義 incoming

senses.en: going out of or away from a place
senses.pattern: outgoing mail / outgoing calls / outgoing flights / the outgoing tide
senses.example: All [[outgoing]] flights were delayed for hours because of the thick fog over the airport.
senses.example_zh: 由於機場上空濃霧瀰漫，所有離境的班機都延誤了好幾個小時。
senses.note: 只置於名詞前；反義 incoming

gsat.sentence: The same strategy for docking a vessel during an incoming tide may not work during an [[outgoing]] tide.

senses.en: to write something
senses.pattern: pen a letter / pen a novel / pen a song / be penned by
senses.example: The retired teacher [[penned]] a touching letter to thank the students who had visited her.
senses.example_zh: 這位退休教師寫了一封感人的信，感謝曾來探望她的學生。
senses.note: 屬書面用語

senses.en: a small enclosed area for farm animals
senses.pattern: a sheep pen / a pig pen / keep animals in a pen
senses.example: Every evening the shepherd drives his sheep into a [[pen]] to keep them safe from wolves.
senses.example_zh: 每天傍晚，牧羊人都把羊趕進圍欄，以免牠們遭到狼的攻擊。

gsat.sentence: And in 1994, Microsoft CEO (chief executive officer) Bill Gates paid $30.8 million for a handwritten notebook [[penned]] by Leonardo da Vinci.

senses.en: the purpose or usefulness of something
senses.pattern: there is no point in doing / see the point / the point of doing sth / what's the point
senses.example: There is no [[point]] in buying an expensive bike if you never plan to ride it.
senses.example_zh: 如果你從不打算騎，買一輛昂貴的腳踏車就沒有意義。

senses.en: the main idea, or an opinion someone puts forward
senses.pattern: make a point / get to the point / miss the point / a good point
senses.example: The speaker talked for an hour, but most listeners still missed the main [[point]] of her argument.
senses.example_zh: 講者講了一個小時，但大多數聽眾仍沒抓到她論述的要點。

senses.en: to suggest that something is true or likely
senses.pattern: point to a problem / point to the fact that / evidence points to
senses.example: All the evidence collected so far [[points]] to human activity as the main cause of the pollution.
senses.example_zh: 目前蒐集到的所有證據都顯示，人類活動是造成污染的主因。

gsat.sentence: I just don’t see the [[point]].
In fact, if it is, it may [[point]] to an injury or muscle strain.

senses.en: original; not coming from something else
senses.pattern: primary sources / primary data / primary colors / primary research
senses.example: Diaries and letters are [[primary]] sources that show historians how ordinary people really lived.
senses.example_zh: 日記和書信是第一手的資料，讓歷史學家了解一般人實際的生活樣貌。
senses.note: primary colors＝原色

senses.en: an election in which a party chooses its candidate
senses.pattern: win a primary / a presidential primary / a primary election
senses.example: In the United States, each major party holds [[primaries]] to choose its candidate for president.
senses.example_zh: 在美國，各大政黨都會舉行黨內初選，以選出總統候選人。
senses.note: 複數 primaries

senses.en: to express something in a particular way
senses.pattern: put it simply / put it another way / to put it mildly / as sb puts it
senses.example: Let me [[put]] it another way: without clean water, no city can survive for long.
senses.example_zh: 讓我換個方式說：沒有乾淨的水，任何城市都無法長久存續。

senses.en: to estimate something to be a certain amount
senses.pattern: put the cost at / put the number at / put the damage at
senses.example: Experts [[put]] the cost of repairing the ancient bridge at more than two million dollars.
senses.example_zh: 專家估計修復這座古橋的費用超過兩百萬美元。
senses.note: 句型：put + 受詞 + at + 數量

gsat.sentence: As one swapper [[puts]] it, “Nobody is going to fly across the ocean or drive 600 miles to come steal your TV.

senses.en: respect or admiration for someone or something
senses.pattern: have a high regard for / hold sb in high regard / be held in high regard
senses.example: The students have a high [[regard]] for their coach, who always treats every player fairly.
senses.example_zh: 學生們非常尊重他們的教練，因為他總是公平對待每位球員。

senses.en: attention to or thought for something
senses.pattern: without regard for / have no regard for / show little regard for
senses.example: Some drivers race through the village with no [[regard]] for the safety of children.
senses.example_zh: 有些駕駛高速駛過村莊，完全不顧及孩童的安全。
senses.note: with regard to＝關於

senses.en: good wishes sent to someone
senses.pattern: give my regards to / send one's regards / best regards / warm regards
senses.example: Please give my warmest [[regards]] to your grandparents when you visit them this weekend.
senses.example_zh: 你這個週末去探望祖父母時，請代我向他們致上最誠摯的問候。
senses.note: 此義恆用複數 regards

senses.en: to shock or shake a place or group of people
senses.pattern: be rocked by a scandal / rock the nation / an explosion rocked the city
senses.example: The small town was [[rocked]] by the news that its only hospital would close next month.
senses.example_zh: 唯一的醫院下個月將關閉的消息，震驚了這座小鎮。
senses.note: rock the boat＝惹麻煩、破壞現狀

senses.en: to move gently backwards and forwards or from side to side
senses.pattern: rock a baby to sleep / rock back and forth / rock gently / a rocking chair
senses.example: The young father gently [[rocked]] the crying baby in his arms until she fell asleep.
senses.example_zh: 年輕的父親把哭泣的寶寶抱在懷裡輕輕搖晃，直到她睡著。

gsat.sentence: If you have ever been sick to your stomach on a [[rocking]] boat or a bumpy car ride, you know the discomfort of motion sickness.

senses.en: to add salt, pepper, or spices to food
senses.pattern: season the soup / season with salt and pepper / season to taste / lightly seasoned
senses.example: The chef [[seasoned]] the fish with lemon juice, garlic, and a pinch of black pepper.
senses.example_zh: 主廚用檸檬汁、大蒜和少許黑胡椒給魚調味。
senses.note: seasoning 調味料；seasoned 經驗豐富的

gsat.sentence: Then pour the popcorn into a bowl and [[season]] with a small amount of real butter or olive oil and natural salt.

senses.en: a metal case filled with explosives, fired from a large gun
senses.pattern: an artillery shell / an unexploded shell / fire shells / a shell exploded
senses.example: Workers building the new road found an unexploded [[shell]] left over from a war decades ago.
senses.example_zh: 修築新道路的工人發現了一枚數十年前戰爭遺留下來的未爆砲彈。
senses.note: 動詞 shell 亦指「砲擊」

senses.en: to remove the shell from nuts, peas, or seafood
senses.pattern: shell peas / shell peanuts / shell shrimp / shelled nuts
senses.example: Grandma sat by the window, [[shelling]] peas for dinner while listening to the radio.
senses.example_zh: 奶奶坐在窗邊，一邊聽收音機，一邊給晚餐要用的豌豆去殼。

senses.en: a small piece of paper
senses.pattern: a slip of paper / a permission slip / a pay slip / a sales slip
senses.example: Each student wrote a wish on a [[slip]] of paper and dropped it into the box.
senses.example_zh: 每位學生把願望寫在一張紙條上，然後投進箱子裡。

senses.en: to go somewhere quietly without being noticed
senses.pattern: slip out of the room / slip away / slip into / slip past sb
senses.example: Not wanting to wake the baby, she [[slipped]] quietly out of the room and closed the door.
senses.example_zh: 她不想吵醒寶寶，便悄悄溜出房間並關上門。

senses.en: a small mistake
senses.pattern: a slip of the tongue / make a slip / one small slip
senses.example: One small [[slip]] during the final dance routine cost the team the championship.
senses.example_zh: 最後一段舞蹈中的一個小失誤，讓這支隊伍痛失冠軍。
senses.note: a slip of the tongue＝口誤

senses.en: interest or excitement added to something
senses.pattern: add spice to / the spice of life / give spice to
senses.example: Traveling to unfamiliar places adds [[spice]] to a life that might otherwise feel boring.
senses.example_zh: 到陌生的地方旅行，能為原本可能乏味的生活增添趣味。
senses.note: 此義不可數

senses.en: to make something more interesting or exciting
senses.pattern: spice up a speech / spice up one's life / spice things up
senses.example: The teacher [[spiced]] up her history lessons with funny stories about ancient kings.
senses.example_zh: 老師用古代國王的趣聞，使她的歷史課更有趣味。

senses.en: to keep something for future use
senses.pattern: store food / store data / store energy / store sth in a cool place
senses.example: Camels [[store]] fat in their humps, which helps them survive long journeys across the desert.
senses.example_zh: 駱駝把脂肪儲存在駝峰裡，這有助於牠們熬過橫越沙漠的長途旅程。
senses.note: 名詞 storage：儲存（空間）

senses.en: a supply of something kept for use when needed
senses.pattern: a store of food / a store of knowledge / a store of energy
senses.example: Squirrels build up a large [[store]] of nuts in autumn to get through the winter.
senses.example_zh: 松鼠在秋天累積大量的堅果儲備，以度過冬天。
senses.note: in store (for sb)＝即將發生

gsat.sentence: According to the passage, what is the best way to [[store]] olive oil?
Olive oil spoils quickly when exposed to direct sunlight, so it should be [[stored]] in the dark at 16-18°C.

senses.en: an important meeting between leaders of governments
senses.pattern: a summit meeting / hold a summit / a climate summit / an economic summit
senses.example: Leaders from forty countries attended the [[summit]] to discuss how to slow global warming.
senses.example_zh: 四十國的領袖出席了這場高峰會，討論如何減緩全球暖化。

senses.en: the flat part on each side of the forehead
senses.pattern: rub one's temples / a pain in the temples / gray hair at the temples
senses.example: The nurse placed a cool towel on the boy's forehead and [[temples]] to bring his fever down.
senses.example_zh: 護士把涼毛巾敷在男孩的額頭和太陽穴上，幫他退燒。
senses.note: 常用複數 temples

senses.en: a job that needs special skill, especially with hands
senses.pattern: learn a trade / a carpenter by trade / the tourist trade / the tools of the trade
senses.example: At sixteen, he left school to learn the carpenter's [[trade]] from his uncle.
senses.example_zh: 他十六歲離開學校，向叔叔學木匠這門手藝。

senses.en: to exchange one thing for another
senses.pattern: trade A for B / trade places / trade seats / trade stories
senses.example: During lunch, Amy [[traded]] her apple for half of her classmate's chocolate cake.
senses.example_zh: 午餐時，艾咪用她的蘋果交換了同學的半塊巧克力蛋糕。

senses.en: used to emphasize the exact person or thing
senses.pattern: the very person / this very moment / the very same / the very thing
senses.example: This is the [[very]] book I have been looking for since the beginning of the semester.
senses.example_zh: 這正是我從學期初就一直在找的那本書。
senses.note: 只置於名詞前，常與 the/this/that 連用

senses.en: used to emphasize an extreme point in place or time
senses.pattern: the very top / the very end / the very beginning / the very back
senses.example: We climbed to the [[very]] top of the tower to watch the sun rise over the sea.
senses.example_zh: 我們爬到塔的最頂端，觀看太陽從海面升起。

senses.en: very excited or enthusiastic; out of control
senses.pattern: go wild / wild cheers / be wild about / wild with joy
senses.example: The crowd went [[wild]] when the home team scored in the last second of the game.
senses.example_zh: 主隊在比賽最後一秒得分時，全場觀眾陷入瘋狂。

senses.en: not based on careful thought or facts
senses.pattern: a wild guess / wild rumors / wild accusations / a wild idea
senses.example: I had no idea how old the bridge was, so I just made a [[wild]] guess.
senses.example_zh: 我完全不知道這座橋有多古老，所以只是胡亂猜了一下。

senses.en: a natural environment far from people
senses.pattern: in the wild / return to the wild / release sth into the wild
senses.example: Pandas raised by humans often find it hard to survive after being released into the [[wild]].
senses.example_zh: 由人類飼養長大的貓熊被放回野外後，往往難以存活。
senses.note: 常用 in the wild；the wilds 指偏遠地區

gsat.sentence: The audience went [[wild]].
To me, a zoo can be a good place for endangered species which have difficulty finding suitable mates in the [[wild]].

quiz.stem: Although the temperature had dropped below zero, dozens of volunteers ______ the cold to deliver hot meals to elderly people living alone.
quiz.explain_zh: brave＝勇敢面對、冒著。志工冒著嚴寒為獨居長者送熱食。

quiz.stem: After the number of new infections had fallen for three weeks, the government finally ______ the ban on large indoor gatherings.
quiz.explain_zh: lift＝解除（禁令）。感染人數連降三週後，政府解除室內大型集會的禁令。

quiz.stem: The story of the greedy dog ends with a simple ______: those who always want more often lose what they already have.
quiz.explain_zh: moral＝寓意、教訓。貪心狗的故事寓意是：貪得無厭的人往往失去原有的東西。

quiz.stem: Because no one had ever tried it before, the team's ______ approach to recycling plastic bottles attracted attention from scientists around the world.
quiz.explain_zh: novel＝新穎的。這個從來沒人試過的回收方法很新穎，因而受到各國科學家注意。

quiz.stem: By selling her design to a technology company, the young inventor earned a ______ sum of money, enough to pay for four years of college.
quiz.explain_zh: handsome＝（金額）可觀的。她賣出設計，賺到一筆足以付四年大學學費的可觀金額。

quiz.stem: The student council launched a food ______ before the Lunar New Year and collected over a thousand cans for families in need.
quiz.explain_zh: drive＝（募集）活動。學生會在年前發起食物募集活動，募得上千個罐頭。

quiz.stem: Whenever she has a bad headache, Ms. Wu closes her eyes and gently massages her ______ with her fingertips until the pain eases.
quiz.explain_zh: temple＝太陽穴。吳女士頭痛時會閉上眼睛，用指尖按摩太陽穴。

quiz.stem: Scientists are examining the bones found in the cave to ______ how long ago these animals lived in the area.
quiz.explain_zh: determine＝查明、確定。科學家檢驗洞穴中的骨頭，以查明這些動物生存的年代。

quiz.stem: Arriving at the station two hours early, we had plenty of time to ______, so we played cards in a nearby café.
quiz.explain_zh: kill＝消磨（時間）。提早兩小時到車站，有很多時間要消磨，所以去打牌。

quiz.stem: The handwriting on the hundred-year-old letter was so ______ that the historians needed a special lamp to read it.
quiz.explain_zh: faint＝模糊的、微弱的。百年信件上的字跡太模糊，要用特殊的燈才能讀。
